title: Serialize Windows SwiftPM tests by default
description: Large Windows SwiftPM test graphs can fail while parallel compiler tasks contend on incremental .priors dependency files, reporting NSCocoaErrorDomain 512 before the executable finishes linking.
acceptanceCriteria: Windows Vaporize SwiftPM tests default to one build job.
An explicit caller-provided --jobs or -j value remains authoritative.
Release tests retain the Windows Swift Testing WMO workaround.
Focused Windows Swift Testing policy tests pass through Vaporize.

evidence.validation: The new Vaporize binary injected --jobs 1 without a caller job flag and passed 4 focused Swift Testing tests in 1 suite. The cold serialized graph took 1,081.08 seconds, so callers retain an explicit job-count override.

resolution: Vaporize now serializes Windows SwiftPM test builds unless the caller explicitly selects a job count.
